title: Declaration
$comment: One declaration, three surfaces (§9.1): under `hcs14` the HCS-11 profile supplies account, doorbell and log and `properties.wishmail` supplies the rest; the `dns` and `nanda` surfaces carry the whole object. No profile reads another to resolve (§9.7). AUTHORED object (§5.1): produced by an actor and validated against this schema. STUB. Tracks §5 of WISHMAIL_SPEC_v0_5.md field for field. Not yet registered under HCS-13: spec/pins.json registeredSchemas is null for this object (T-P9-4, T-P9-9). The specification leads, the schema follows, the tests are the court: where a constraint below is not expressible in JSON Schema, the named test is what holds it.

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

doorbell.description: Its HCS-10 inbound topic. Carries a HIP-991 fee of exactly one stamp, collected by the treasury (§4.4, T-P7-4).

manifestTopic.description: Its manifest topic: memo `wishmail:manifest:1`, sole submit key the agent’s (§9.1, T-P17-3).
